source: Wbudowany Sunburst, na podstawie autorskiego arkusza Ognistego Chochlika z Emberfall
prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Edit the supplied Emberfall fire imp character model sheet into precisely four NEW directional animation keys. This is a matching art asset for an existing painted 2D game, a continuation of a turntable. Repaint the same single creature in the SAME rest pose, in a 2-by-2 grid, only the character's heading changes. Uniform fixed slightly elevated isometric game camera like reference, fixed light from upper left, warm dark copper scales, small amber eyes, two grey ringed swept horns, copper leaf shoulder scales, ragged belt skirt with plain rectangular buckle, cloven black hooves, exactly two clawed hands and one long thin spade tail. Keep exactly the same head width/body proportions, stance and expression as the original. Four specific missing azimuths: top left at 22.5 degrees from straight towards the viewer toward screen RIGHT (almost frontal with both sides still clearly visible); top right at 67.5 degrees (nearly right profile with a little chest); bottom left at 112.5 degrees (right profile rotating slightly AWAY from view with side of head, chin and some back); bottom right at 157.5 degrees (nearly direct rear with a small portion of right-facing cheek). Turn the entire body including hips/feet/head together; fixed horns, claws, wingless anatomy. Tail fixed relative to pelvis naturally projected and emerging from rump. No duplicated/disconnected features. Beautiful crisp polished painterly emberfall RPG art matching the supplied original, unchanged material edges, decisive contours, individual scale plates, hard brows, sharply articulated fingers and hooves. All four isolated full-body poses on actual transparent alpha, separated by generous clear gutters, identical pixel height and foot baseline within each row. Exactly one complete imp in each of the four quadrants. No shadows, background, typography, labels, effects, trails, blur or motion lines. Frame each whole sprite, tail tip, horn tip and feet inside its own grid cell. Do not copy the main frontal, three-quarter, exact side or exact back poses already present in the reference: these are intervening poses between them.
